title: Search across the rooms a user is in, kept current from room events
spec: Implement RoomSearch as its doc comments say, composing search::Index (one per room), html_text::html_text and server::Server (shown for reference). Replace the `_todo` field. No new dependencies. html_text (T141) may still be a todo!() stub when you write tests; build expected values from plain text with no markup.
